verdict.rationale: Bento documents a beginner DNS onboarding guide in which users add DNS records that "authenticate your domain and allow Bento to send email on your behalf." Its docs landing page also lists "authenticate your sending domain" as a core setup step, so guided domain authentication is clearly delivered. However, the evidence never names SPF, DKIM or DMARC, and never describes a verification check. Missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment coverage, documented in-app DNS verification/status checking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
